replication_status: exact (authors' code reproduces the shipped log, whose 6 post bins equal printed Table 11 column (4) q+1..q+6 = 0.153, 0.158, 0.182, 0.152, 0.145, 0.163 (t = 0.762, 0.556, 0.467, 0.325, 0.275, 0.271) to the printed decimals; published_coef 0.1588333 is their equal-weight average (log average 0.15896051666666666); N 2,013; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
replication_vs_log: exact (fixest = authors' reghdfe keepsing log to all printed digits; N and clusters match)
notes: Sustainalytics ESG score (improvement file). Authors' code (9. table 6a b/table 6a_regression.do, line 29): reghdfe sust_esgscore_alt t_plus1 ... t_plus6 if j>-8 & j<6, a(wficn1 yearqtr) cluster(wficn1) keepsing. Sample: fund-quarter panel, opentonewinv==1 and row-count event quarter j in -7..5 (j counts panel rows from the first post-signing row, so it differs from calendar distance when a fund's panel has gaps). Treatment D = post_pri = 1 from the fund's first post-signing quarter (absorbing in calendar time, verified); gvar = gpost. fixest (fixef.rm = none) reproduces the log: coef 0.1589605 vs 0.1589605, N 2013 vs 2013, clusters 186 vs 186. Regression sample: N = 2013, 186 funds, 33 consecutive quarters. Cohorts (first post-signing quarter): 25, of which 24 have both treated and untreated rows in the sample. In 27 of the 33 treated periods another cohort supplies untreated rows (not-yet-signed funds; no never-treated funds). Funds observed only after signing in the sample (always-treated within sample): 23 (4.3% of rows); funds observed only before signing: 2. Event study: the authors' dynamic columns use post-only bins t_plus1..t_plus6 (= row-count j = 0..5) with all pre-signing rows pooled as the reference. run_spec.R with event_pre_min = 0 and event_post_max = 5 reproduces this structure (pre rows -> reference -1) but bins by CALENDAR relative time; 0 treated rows fall in a different bin and 0 rows with calendar relative time > 5 go to the separate endpoint bin (excluded from the post average). Authors' post average (equal weight over the 6 bins) = 0.158961; calendar-bin TWFE post average on the same sample = 0.158961 (raw units). A fully dynamic specification with leads is not used because, without never-treated funds, unit FE + period FE + all relative-time dummies are collinear. Table/column labels are inferred from package folder names and code order (no article text). run_spec.R also maps funds that signed before the first sample period to period 1, which shifts their relative-time bins (TVL spec: 35 funds, 113 rows).

event_structure.source: 9. table 6a b/table 6a_regression.do line 29: reghdfe sust_esgscore_alt t_plus1-t_plus6 if j>-8 & j<6, a(wficn1 yearqtr) cluster(wficn1) keepsing. t_plusk = 1[j == k-1] (verified), where j is the authors' ROW-COUNT event quarter (1. building data/3_2.x-section.sas lines 316-350: j = 0 at the fund's first post-signing row, +-1 per panel row); all pre-signing rows (j = -7..-1) are the pooled reference and the j window is the sample filter. Pipeline rel = q - gpost (gpost = q at j == 0 for every fund; true pre-sample signing quarters are in gvar). rel = j except after a gap in the fund's quarterly panel (then rel > j). The last bin is open ([5,null]) so that treated rows with j <= 5 but rel > 5 stay in a post bin and the authors' N is kept.
event_structure.verified: TWFE with these bins on j reproduces the 6 logged coefficients, max abs diff 4.8e-08 (log rounding), N 2013; j equals calendar rel on every row of this sample, so the calendar (CSA) bins are identical.

event_time_authors_note: Lead decision (Nov 2): TWFE indicators and the imputation estimator's observation-level bin averages use the bins and ref of event_structure on the authors' row-count event quarter j (column j of the data file; no NA in the sample); DiD-averaging (CSA) cells are calendar (g,t) cells and use rel = t - g with the same bin boundaries. uncovered = ref (no drop).
presample_adopters_nov2: 18 funds (58 rows) signed before the first sample period; their true signing period is in gvar, so no adoption_var is needed.
